title: Adversarial convergence-versus-correctness controls

cases.name: CORRECT_CONTROL
cases.description: single physical storage and correctly signed input

cases.name: DUPLICATE_STORAGE
cases.description: MODFLOW owns full S=0.20 while API also removes another full S=0.20 response

cases.name: WRONG_STORAGE_SIGN
cases.description: MODFLOW owns S=0.15 while intended S=0.05 API storage share is published with positive rather than negative HCOF

cases.name: REVERSED_FORCING_SIGN
cases.description: the intended +0.010 m input is published as -0.010 m

gates: correct control matches physical head within 1e-10 m
each adversarial case matches its independently predicted wrong signature within 1e-10 m
each adversarial case is distinguishable from the intended physical oracle
at least one converged adversarial case violates the intended physical mass ledger by more than 1e-3 m
interpretation: subsystem numerical convergence is necessary but not sufficient evidence of coupling correctness.
forbidden: do not weaken mass or physics gates because MODFLOW converged
